title: DiffResearch: Accelerating Deep Research with Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28909v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use. Almost all production systems are built on autoregressive (AR) language models and inherit left-to-right decoding in planning and long-form writing. We present DiffResearch, an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model (dLLM) at the core of every stage, and measure how a diffusion backbone changes latency and report quality. Holding the agentic scaffold, retrieval code, prompts, and evaluation fixed, we swap the backbone between an open diffusion model and a comparable AR model. Across 100 Deep Research Bench tasks, the diffusion backbone is roughly 6 times faster end-to-end, driven by order-of-magnitude reductions in planning and writing. We further introduce dFast, a decomposition mode that reads intermediate denoising states and extracts subqueries before

translated_title: DiffResearch：利用扩散语言模型加速深度研究
translated_abstract: 深度研究系统需要迭代地进行规划、收集证据、综合整理和修订，这使得端到端延迟成为交互式使用的关键瓶颈。几乎所有生产系统都建立在自回归（AR）语言模型之上，在规划和长篇写作中继承了从左到右的解码方式。我们提出了DiffResearch，一个开放的多智能体深度研究框架，它将扩散语言模型置于每个阶段的核心，并测量扩散骨干网络如何改变延迟和报告质量。在保持智能体脚手架、检索代码、提示词和评估不变的情况下，我们在开放扩散模型和可比较的自回归模型之间交换骨干网络。在100个Deep Research Bench任务中，扩散骨干网络的端到端速度提升约6倍，这主要源于规划和写作环节数量级的延迟降低。我们进一步引入了dFast，一种分解模式，它读取中间去噪状态并提前提取子查询……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: DiffResearch是一个将扩散语言模型置于每个阶段核心的开放多智能体深度研究框架，在相同评估条件下端到端速度比自回归模型快约6倍，并通过dFast分解模式进一步提升效率。
en_tdlr: DiffResearch is an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model at the core of every stage, achieving roughly 6x faster end-to-end speed than comparable autoregressive models, further enhanced by the dFast decomposition mode that reads intermediate denoising states and extracts subqueries early.
